clue.text: Smooth butter around can for a bird

parts.note: to sand wood is to smooth it

indicators.note: around tells us the word for butter is turned round

parts.note: a ram is an animal that butts
a can is a tin

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: smear butter around a tin before cooking some bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butter' wants to be the dairy spread; here it is an animal that butts, and 'around' turns that word round before the can follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The sand martin is a small brown swallow-like species that nests in riverbank burrows.

clue.text: Juice around left cuff

indicators.note: around says the juice word goes round the letter for left

parts.note: sap is the juice of a plant

explanation.surface: A fashion note about juice spilled around the left shirt cuff.
explanation.definitionFit: To cuff someone is to strike them with the open hand, the same blow as a slap.

clue.text: Spots section that's new

indicators.note: something new made from the word section means its letters are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone spots a newspaper section that has been newly added.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean catches sight of or observes something.

clue.text: Standing up for the losers of this tuneful party game

definitions.text: Standing up for the losers of this tuneful party game

parts.words: Standing up for the losers of this tuneful party game
parts.note: in this children's game players circle seats while music plays; when it stops, whoever finds no seat is left standing and is out

explanation.walkthrough: 'Standing up for' reads as defending the losers, but literally the losers are those left on their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: This party game uses music and a row of seats, one fewer than the players, so losers end up standing.

clue.text: Rose quickly joined short biker and 1950s lad

indicators.note: short says the biker word loses its final letter

parts.note: a rocker was a leather-clad motorcyclist of 1960s Britain
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style dress

explanation.surface: A tale of a rapid rise after a biker teamed up with a lad from the fifties.
explanation.walkthrough: Rockers and Teds were rival British youth cults of the 1950s and 60s.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that rocketed shot upward fast, like a firework, so it rose quickly.

clue.text: Cut is bad -recurrence of disease results

indicators.note: bad suggests the words cut is are spoiled, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that a bad cut can lead to the disease coming back.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine, an ictus is a sudden attack or fit, such as a seizure returning in a recurring illness.

clue.text: All but perfect in thought

indicators.note: all but means nearly all, so the final letter of the word for perfect is dropped

parts.note: ideal means perfect

explanation.surface: Someone is nearly perfect in their thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A thought and a notion or concept are the same thing as an idea.

clue.text: Tooth? He tends it if broken

definitions.text: Tooth? He tends it if broken

indicators.note: broken signals that the letters of tends it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tooth question answered: this person looks after it when it breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer: the person who tends a broken tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: A dental practitioner repairs damaged teeth, which is what the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Top pilot eats exotic treacle to go faster

indicators.note: eats means the pilot word takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: an ace is a top fighter pilot

indicators.note: exotic suggests something unusual, so the letters of treacle are rearranged

explanation.surface: A star pilot eats a strange sweet syrup to gain speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top pilot' is a fighter ace, not the first letter of pilot; 'exotic' scrambles the syrup, and 'eats' puts the scramble inside, splitting the pilot word after its second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To accelerate is to pick up speed, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Singers in original Tosca

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words original Tosca

explanation.surface: Singers appearing in the first production of Puccini's opera Tosca.
explanation.definitionFit: Altos are singers with a low female or high male voice range.

clue.text: Not very lively puss needs a pick-me-up

parts.note: puss is a pet name for a cat
a tonic is a restorative drink

explanation.surface: A sluggish cat needs something to perk it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone catatonic is in a stupor, unresponsive, so hardly lively at all; understated humour.

clue.text: Sadly on health diet eating nothing but this? doubt it!

definitions.text: Sadly on health diet eating nothing but this? doubt it!

indicators.note: eating says the rearranged letters take the nothing letter inside them
sadly signals that the letters of on health diet are rearranged

parts.note: O, a round zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Doubt that anyone on a health diet would eat only this stodgy dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes a fatty sausage dish no dieter would live on. It is a British dish of sausages baked in batter.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional British dish of sausages in Yorkshire pudding batter, hardly health food, which the clue's jibe captures.

clue.text: Dog Caroline pecks when drunk

indicators.note: being drunk means the letters of Caroline pecks are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dog is kissed by Caroline when she has had too much.
explanation.definitionFit: This breed is a small gundog with long silky ears, an example of a dog.

clue.text: Valuable business employed forward

indicators.note: employed is used in the sense of taken in, putting the business letters inside

parts.note: precious means valuable
CO is the abbreviation for company, a business

explanation.surface: A valuable firm takes on staff for advancement.
explanation.definitionFit: A forward child is advanced beyond their age, the sense of precocious.

clue.text: Decided on finished puzzle

parts.note: RE means on or concerning
a puzzle that is finished has been solved

explanation.surface: Someone made up their mind about a completed crossword.
explanation.definitionFit: Having resolved something, you have decided on it firmly.

clue.text: Nipper consumed first tin of beer

indicators.note: consumed means the nipper word swallows the other letter

parts.note: a biter is something that nips

indicators.note: first takes just the opening letter of tin

explanation.surface: A child drinks the first tin of beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nipper' usually means a child but here is one who nips, a BITER.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter is a well-hopped British draught ale, a type of beer.

clue.text: Type of medicine for bad colitis, taken at hospital

indicators.note: bad means the letters of colitis are disordered

explanation.surface: A form of treatment for a bad bout of colitis given in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Holistic medicine treats the whole person rather than just symptoms, a kind of medical approach.

clue.text: Leaders in clinical research examine revolutionary nursery

indicators.note: leaders are the opening letters of the next three words

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: Scientists inspect a nursery after a clinical study.
explanation.definitionFit: A crèche is a day nursery where young children are minded.

clue.text: To make money is, in France, businesslike

parts.note: to earn is to make money
est is French for is

explanation.surface: In France, making money is a serious affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone earnest is serious and purposeful, a close sense of businesslike.

clue.text: Conservative secretary takes time to show disrespect

parts.note: a temp is a temporary secretary

explanation.surface: A Tory aide is slow and treats people rudely.
explanation.definitionFit: Contempt is scorn, a strong form of disrespect.

clue.text: Guy with court's authorisation and …

parts.note: a guy is a man
to court is to woo or date someone

explanation.surface: A man brings the court's authority, with more to follow in the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' is not a law court but the verb to woo.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandate is an official authority or commission to act.

clue.text: Sky News presenter in a flap?

definitions.text: Sky News presenter in a flap?

parts.words: Sky News presenter in a flap?
parts.note: not the TV channel: a bird that brings news through the sky, flapping its wings

explanation.walkthrough: Sky News is a British TV news channel, but here the sky is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: Homing birds once carried messages across the sky, so this bird delivered news while flapping.

clue.text: … guy received and understood

definitions.meaning: A man's name, so any chap
the radio operator's word confirming a message got through

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses link this to the previous clue, continuing its sentence; the link is only surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Radio procedure uses this word to confirm receipt, and it is also a common male name.

clue.text: Attend policeman's regular route

definitions.meaning: attend read as ..., being present somewhere
the area a constable patrols on foot

explanation.walkthrough: 'Attend' read as two words, BE AT.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer walks a beat, and to attend is to be at a place.

clue.text: Management's unintentional omission

definitions.meaning: supervision or control of an operation
a mistake made by failing to notice something

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both supervision and a careless slip.

clue.text: Make speech about Newton flashy!

annotationWithheld.why: Make speech about Newton flashy (5): ORATE looks like ORNATE without N, but 'about' cannot signal removal of Newton; the clue as held lacks a deletion indicator and no search found the original

clue.text: We hear quote from internet location

indicators.note: we hear signals the word is said out loud

parts.note: to cite is to quote

explanation.surface: Quoting something we heard from a website.
explanation.definitionFit: A website is a location on the internet.

clue.text: Such happens outside the field of athletics

definitions.text: Such happens outside the field of athletics

parts.words: Such happens outside the field of athletics
parts.note: athletics divides into field events and running events held on the surrounding oval, literally outside the field

explanation.definitionFit: Races run on the oval around the infield are this category of athletics contest, opposed to field events.
